title: Technical Product Documentation - Handling of Computer-Based Technical Information, Part 2: Original Documentation
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15024 (PART 2)) covers Technical Product Documentation - Handling of Computer-Based Technical Information, Part 2: Original Documentation. This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 1 1442 : 2006 Technical product documentation — Document management' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Production and General Engineering Division Council. This standard was originally published in 2001 in four parts which were identical with ISO 1 1 442 -1 to 4 : 1 993. This first revision has been harmonized with ISO 1 1 442 : 2006 by adoption to make pace with the latest developments taken place at international level. The Committee has decided that in addition to the above standards, IS 1 5025 : 2001 Technical product documentation — Requirements for computer-aided design and draughting — Vocabulary' shall be treated as withdrawn after publication of this standard. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
